facts.fact: Gabonclic reports the national fibre backbone, run by Axione Gabon along the railway line, carried internet, mobile and fixed telephony in the Ogooue-Ivindo, Woleu-Ntem, Ogooue-Lolo and Haut-Ogooue provinces until it was cut at PK 289 in the Lope on 24 August 2026 (about 09:40); partial outage, repairs under way on 25 August.

systems.tiers: ISPs and mobile operators (Moov Africa, Airtel) depend on it
